lines.text: *Whoooosh*
The bow of the boat slices through the ocean currents, causing waves to splash all around.
The sunlight is so piercingly bright that I have to squint.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: I can see an island up ahead.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Ooh! I see it!

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Can we get something to eat first? I've been so nervous about this that I haven't eaten since yesterday.

lines.speaker: maiden_s
lines.text: What should we eat?

lines.speaker: guilty
lines.text: I'm good with anything.

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: Meat! I want meat!

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Did you all cook up some barbecue last summer?

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: We certainly did! Oh my goodness, that was delicious.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: You bet it was, and you know who you can thank for that?

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Me, Neon, the God of Fire! I handled all the cooking. You shoulda seen me, even the God of the Sea genuflected before me!

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: I hope we get a chance to taste it as well.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Well, it appears I have no choice but to unleash my secret skills once more...
Everyone seems excitable and in high spirits...
Except for the two people in front.
When did you learn to commandeer a boat, Rosanna?

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Don't remember.
... I see.
What about you, Sakura? Did you ever learn how to sail?

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: No.
... Alright then.
Two days ago.
Mustang filled me in briefly.
They have to partake in a photoshoot up on the surface?

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Yeah. They stirred up some major trouble, so they're getting sent to the beach.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: They'll be the models, and you can take the photos.
... I'm not entirely sure why this led to me being recruited, but okay.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Here, take this.
Moran hands me a film camera.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Apparently the film is somewhat limited, so you have to be discerning when taking photos.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: I asked if we could use our phones, but they said that doesn't have the same feel.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Anyway, Mustang said he would take care of everything else, so don't worry.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: He even scouted out a great location that you'll be going to.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: I wonder how he manages to get all this done so quickly...

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Er...

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Cadet, you've gotta help me.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: These two have been out of it ever since they were told about the photoshoot,

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: constantly bellyaching about how this kind of thing is beneath

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: the leaders of an organization like them.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Help me cheer them up, will ya? I'm dyin' over here.
Hmm...
Wow! I can't wait to see you two in swimsuits!
It's not working.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Anyway, be sure to take the Counters with you.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: It'll be on the surface, so it would be best to have a team of specialists on hand in case things go south.
I'm sure they'll be more than happy to join us.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: I bet. Lounging on the beach is something pretty much every Nikke dreams about.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Arrrrgh, I wanna go too!

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: I'd much rather hang out by the sea than have to deal with all this Underworld Queen crap.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: If a certain two individuals hadn't made such a mess of things, I'd have been able to join you.

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: Sorry.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Sorry.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Huh? What are you two apologizing for?

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: I thought you both were pissed off about all this.

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Sorry.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: W-what's gotten into you two lunkheads?! I deserve to go up there more than either of you two!

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Anyway, I've gotta get going.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: There are a couple more people tagging along, and they'll be here soon.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: This is my cue to leave. Goodbye.
Wait, shouldn't you tell me who they are?

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Sorry, but seeing Rosanna and Sakura so apologetic is creeping me out.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: It's like I'm watching someone pretend to be them.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: It gives me the willies! I'm outta here.
Moran scurries off.
In her absence, a sullen and moribund atmosphere engulfs the room.
*Zing*

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Honey!

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: Hey there, Commander!
Huh? What's going on?

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: I decided to come along for the photoshoot.

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: Me too!

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: The Boss recently started a magazine called AMOR TETRA,

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: and I was the cover model for the first issue.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Soooo, consider me an advisor. I'm here to offer some tips with photography, location scouting, and what kind of poses to go for.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Not to mention I'm getting a chance to see the ocean! This sounds like a dream, hehe.

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: I'll be assisting you both.

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: I'll get to run around, carry heavy things, and eat delicious grub!

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Hehe, I figured Jackal would get a lot out of this, so I asked to bring her along.
Alright then, welcome to the team.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Thanks!
*Zing*

lines.speaker: guilty
lines.text: Umm...

lines.speaker: guilty
lines.text: I've been told I'll be going as well.
Guilty?

lines.speaker: guilty
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: guilty
lines.text: Many of the people being sent on this mission have violent tendencies,

lines.speaker: guilty
lines.text: and I've been tasked with putting a stop to any scuffles that may occur.
They put you in charge of keeping confrontations to a minimum?

lines.speaker: guilty
lines.text: Correct.

lines.speaker: guilty
lines.text: We'll be heading into unknown territory,

lines.speaker: guilty
lines.text: so we may well encounter situations where physical strength is required.
Understood.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: They're letting a known criminal from the Rehabilitation Center like you wander freely?

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: I know her! She is supposed to be super strong.

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: People say she can crush a rock with her bare hands.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: So what? You can do that too.

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: Oh yeah... I guess you're right. If I use my teeth, that is.

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: Does that mean I'm strong too?

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Of course it does.
*Zing*

lines.speaker: maiden_s
lines.text: Hello, Comman...

lines.speaker: maiden_s
lines.text: Oh wow... there sure are a lot of people here.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Close your eyes, Jackal. Pretend you didn't see her.

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: Alright.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Who are you?

lines.speaker: maiden_s
lines.text: The name's Maiden. I've been assigned as your security escort.

lines.speaker: maiden_s
lines.text: Nice to meet you.
We've been given an escort?
Maiden leans over and whispers in my ear.

lines.speaker: maiden_s
lines.text: Mr. Mustang requested that my boss have me come and keep an eye on Guilty.

lines.speaker: maiden_s
lines.text: Not to mention Rosanna and Sakura. I doubt they'll cause any trouble, but you never know.

lines.speaker: maiden_s
lines.text: I've also been assigned to protect you, so I have a lot on my shoulders.
If your mission is so serious, why are you in a swimsuit?

lines.speaker: maiden_s
lines.text: I got excited about getting to go to the beach.
... Anyway, is that everyone?

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: What about the Counters?
They're waiting with Mary.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Mary is coming?

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: Eep! That scary doctor is gonna be there too?

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: So not only do we have two gang bosses in tow...

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: Eek!

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: We're also cavorting with a known criminal...

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: Eek!!

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: Th-there are only scary people...

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: And now we've got a security guard keeping tabs on us!

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: ... Eek?

lines.speaker: maiden_s
lines.text: ... I'm glad you're not terrified of me, but that reaction was a bit...
Let's head out.
Back to the present.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Commander, we'll be arriving soon.
Alright, everyone get ready to disembark.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Oh my gosh, it's the ocean!

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: The ocean!

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Come on, you guys! You too, Rapi.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Quickly, quickly!

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: The ocean!

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: The ocean!

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Th-the ocean...

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: Hehe, it's been a while.

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: It feels just as wonderful as before.

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: First things first, I'll locate a building that we can use as a clinic.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: We'll also proceed with our assigned tasks...

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Just a moment.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: What's gotten into you guys? We're at the sea, aren't we? The first thing we should be doing is change into our swimsuits.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I couldn't agree more.

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: Hehe, you're right. It's been some time since we were here, so I suppose it slipped our minds.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: You wait here for a bit, Honey.

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: Er... Viper, I didn't bring a swimsuit.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: What? Didn't I tell you to pack one?

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: They're so uncomfortable!

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: *Sigh*...

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: You'd understand the appeal if there was someone you had feelings for.

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: Feelings? I've got plenty of feelings! I like you, and I like Commander too!

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Hehe, alright alright.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Can you at least help me put on my swimsuit?

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: Sure!

lines.speaker: guilty
lines.text: Um... Counselor,

lines.speaker: guilty
lines.text: should I be wearing a swimsuit as well?

lines.speaker: guilty
lines.text: You may have to help me put it on,

lines.speaker: guilty
lines.text: since my hands are restrained.

lines.speaker: guilty
lines.text: I need your help.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Steady now, girlie.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: I'll do it for you.

lines.speaker: guilty
lines.text: But I don't trust you...

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Come on, don't be like that! You can trust me.
Everyone heads off to change,
except for Sakura, Rosanna, and Maiden.

lines.speaker: maiden_s
lines.text: Well, this is a bit awkward, isn't it?
Aren't you two going to go change?

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Don't feel like it.

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: Me neither.
That's a shame. I was really looking forward to seeing you two in a swimsuit.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: You've already seen me in spicier clothes than that, so why make such a big deal about these stupid bikinis?

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: {AccountData.NickName}-kun,

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: I'm not quite following.

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: What's Rosanna talking about?

lines.speaker: maiden_s
lines.text: Oh, right! I... er... I just remembered that I left something somewhere else. I better go fetch it.
You just got here.

lines.speaker: maiden_s
lines.text: I-I lived here in a previous life. My ancestors told me in a dream yesterday about a hidden item around here that'll boost my stats.
What in the world are you blabbering about? Stay here.

lines.speaker: maiden_s
lines.text: Be right back.
Maiden scampers off.
Hey! Aren't you supposed to be here to protect me?!

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: {AccountData.NickName}-kun?

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: What's going on, Mister? Why aren't you saying anything?

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Sorry to keep you waiting.
